description: Check remaining USD balance, call count, active status, and ISO expiration timestamp for an existing `x402s_...` prepaid session token minted via open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay. Pass `session_token` (required `x402s_...` string). Returns `active`, `remaining_usd`, `calls_made`, and `expires_at`; returns HTTP 404/invalid error if the token is unknown or expired. Do not use to create a new session (use open_agent_session). Free and read-only (never consumes free-trial quota).

session_token.description: Prepaid x402s_... session token to inspect.

name: get_agent_session_status
title: Check prepaid session balance & expiry
